changelog:
v0.5.3
- Restore Jellyfin download submissions with MediaForge 1.6 provider responses and internal queue dispatch
- Validate language and provider choices before storing and again before approval
- Use MediaForge's authoritative default download-path resolver with a 1.5 compatibility fallback
- Diagnose missing API-key scopes and outdated companion modules in the connection test
- Prevent the Requests UI from silently submitting an unavailable default provider
description: Searches the movie and TV sources enabled in MediaForge directly from Jellyfin. Users can request downloads; administrators can approve them or enable automatic mode.
name: MediaForge Requests
overview: MediaForge search and download requests for all Jellyfin users
